secrets.name: WIX_API_KEY
secrets.description: Wix API key for CLI authentication. Obtain from https://manage.wix.com/account/api-keys. Used to run 'wix login --api-key' and 'wix env pull' to populate .env.local with WIX_CLIENT_ID, WIX_CLIENT_INSTANCE_ID, WIX_CLIENT_PUBLIC_KEY, WIX_CLIENT_SECRET. Required only once to set up auth; auth is persisted in the wix_auth Docker volume.
